messages.subject: question about weighted regression line
parts:
Hi ggplotters,

I am attempting to place a weighted regression line on a scatterplot and have come up with 2 possible solutions. Based on the code, it seems like both should result in the identical placements of the intercept and slope but they are different (intercept varies). Not sure what is going on but help in understanding this is appreciated. The syntax for both graphs are below along with attachments of the two outputs. 

#graph 1
gg.reg1 <- lm(del ~ n.sess, weights=wt.del) #weighting in regression
lm_smooth<-geom_smooth(method=lm,size=1,data= gg.reg1,se=FALSE)
qplot(n.sess,del,data=grief2, size=wt.del)+lm_smooth 

#graph 2
lm_smooth<-geom_smooth(method=lm,size=1,se=FALSE)
qplot(n.sess,del,data=grief2, weight=wt.del,size=wt.del)+lm_smooth #weighting
#in qplot

Thanks,

AC Del Re
